brief: A phone charging station: a closed box with a cover that lets a cable pass through.

requirements.evidence: One hex base with top cover (cable), bottom cover and 6 side caps – fully enclosed cell (caps added by capOpenFaces).

requirements.requirement: Cover that lets a cable pass through
requirements.evidence: Top cover set to type 'cable' (cover:0,0,0;full;top stem=cable) – slotted cover designed for cable entry; bottom cable-coil prop inside illustrates cable routing, phone on top shows use as charging station.

finish.summary: Built single-cell closed box: top = cable-type cover, bottom cover, all side faces capped. Staged with phone on top and cable coil inside/to show charging use.
